text:
Maya (partnerships): Quick sync — noticed duplicate claims on the same SI-sourced accounts (Acme-type cases). We need a concise rule set for lead ownership + account mapping. Proposed: 36h claim window for SI leads, deterministic tie-breaker if AE has an active relationship. Thoughts?

Evan (AE): 36h sounds fine. Can we do 48h? sometimes AEs are OOO. Also how do we detect SI-sourced leads reliably? partner_id metadata?

Priya (partner-ops): Intake will carry source=SI plus partner_id and partner_role. partner-ops can auto-route SI leads into an SI-queue. 36h is OK from ops perspective.

Rosa (si-lead): Tie-breaker idea: if AE has existing ACV >=25k OR any logged activity in last 90d, AE gets assignment. Otherwise SI claim stands. If both claim, escalate to Partnerships queue for manual adjudication.

Noah (pm): I want this codified as routing rules. Pseudocode example below so eng can implement: 
```
# routing logic (conceptual)
if lead.source == \"SI\":
  if AE.has_relationship(acv >= 25000 or last_touch <= 90d):
    assign_to(AE)
  elif partner.claimed_within(hours=36):
    assign_to(SI)
  else:
    open_compete_to(AE_queue, SI_queue)
```

Sam (legal): Make sure this aligns to our partner contracts — revenue attribution and crediting rules can vary by agreement. Also flag any leads that contain PII for DPA checks (don't auto-assign).

Priya (partner-ops): We'll add lead tags: requires-dpa, sensitive=true, partner_id=, source=SI. partner-ops can block auto-assignment if requires-dpa is set.

Evan (AE): Ops ask: Can we send a Slack alert to #partnerships when there is a conflicting claim? Workflow: reaction emoji within 36h to accept assignment; otherwise default rule applies.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: rule "si_claim_window" = 36h created in routing-service (staging).

Maya (partnerships): Pilot plan: roll this to SI partner group "Titanium" next week for 2 weeks. Priya — can you run a duplicate-claim sweep and post weekly CSVs?

Priya (partner-ops): Yep — I'll run a sweep and post results to #partnerships. Will include fields: lead_id, partner_id, ae_owner, claim_timestamps, resolution.

Rosa (si-lead): :thumbsup: I'll update the SI onboarding checklist with the claim window and escalation steps. Also add a section on account mapping (canonical account id).

Evan (AE): One more: co-sell scenario where both SI and AE actively contributed — suggest a default co-ownership flow with tags (co-owned) and a default revenue split template (70/30 by default) until legal finalizes.

Sam (legal): We'll review the revenue split template. Need to surface contract exceptions as part of partner metadata so ops can honor them.

Maya (partnerships): Great. I'll draft the short SOP and share by EOD Friday. Tagging @here so PMs and Sales know this is upcoming.

Rosa (si-lead): Noted — will coordinate with partner success for comms to Titanium.

Priya (partner-ops): starting the pilot: will enable staging rules tomorrow and schedule the sweep.

Evan (AE): Thanks — appreciate the clarity.

Maya (partnerships): Closing note: success metrics for pilot = <5% duplicate claims at resolution, median resolution time <48h, and clear audit trail for revenue attribution. We'll reconvene after 2 weeks.
